issues.fix: Drop the entry, or keep it only with the website blanked and an explicit 'status unconfirmed / may be closed' note after a phone check.

issues.problem: Not in the zone. The company's own About page says it is 'located in the heart of Bernardsville, NJ' and markets to Morris/Somerset County; the cited URL is only a geo landing page ('Serving Customers in Dayton, NJ').
issues.fix: Remove - out of zone (service-area page, not a Dayton business).

issues.claim: Gun Vault USA (3570 NJ-27) and Better Home Store (3562 NJ-27 #122a) both list phone (732) 659-3119
issues.problem: One number attributed to two businesses. Better Home's own site gives 3570 State Route 27, Suite 122A with 732-659-3119, so the number is Better Home's; Gun Vault USA reads as an online tactical-gear retailer whose address comes from third-party directories.
issues.fix: Drop the phone from Gun Vault USA and verify it actually has a Kendall Park storefront before keeping it.

issues.fix: Fill these in; leave only genuinely unknown fields blank.

issues.claim: Dayton and South Brunswick's Best After School Program - daytonafterschool.com
issues.problem: The cited website would not load on two attempts, and no independent source confirms an after-school program operating at 485 Georges Rd #117 (that complex does host Kumon Dayton at #116 and Promissory at #119). Mapper's own note flags a shared phone with a martial arts academy.
issues.fix: Verify by phone or drop; the name also reads like a keyword-stuffed listing title rather than a trading name.

issues.claim: Amato's Garden Center - 'US Highway 130 & Deans-Rhode Hall Rd, Dayton'
issues.problem: State agriculture listings give 47 Deans Rhode Hall Road, Monmouth Junction 08852, phone 732-297-6790, which does not match the mapper's Dayton town and 732-297-6904 phone (the corner location is right, the town/ZIP and phone are not confirmed).
issues.fix: Use the state-listed street address and phone, or mark both unverified.

issues.claim: Kendall Park Pet Care Grooming - town 'Princeton (Kendall Park area)'
issues.problem: Listed at 4222 Route 27, Princeton NJ 08540 - a Princeton/Franklin-side address, not a South Brunswick/Kendall Park one; the only Kendall Park tie is the business name and directory category.
issues.fix: Remove or move to the correct zone; do not count it as a Kendall Park business.

issues.claim: Little Learners Pre-School (1 New Rd) and Dubrow's Nurseries (Monmouth Junction Rd)
issues.problem: Neither could be confirmed as currently operating - Little Learners appears only in an apartment-community directory and Dubrow's only in aggregator pages that themselves hedge on whether it is still open.
issues.fix: Mark both as unverified and confirm by phone before the triage team spends time on them.

issues.problem: Searches in categories with many eligible independents in the zone returned almost nothing that is on the list: four dentists, four roofing contractors, three salons plus two nail salons, a plumber, an auto-repair shop and four physical-therapy clinics are all absent. If these categories belong to group D, coverage is far below 70%. Even counting only the categories the list already covers (childcare, dance/arts, print, dry cleaning, nurseries, furniture, manufacturing), about 11 of 15 eligible finds are listed.
issues.fix: Add the missing entries below (or confirm these categories sit in another group letter before spending time on the list).

issues.problem: Within the list's own categories, three eligible businesses are missing: The Dance Collective NJ (3570 NJ-27), Crossroads Nursery (981 Georges Rd, on Route 130) and Sign N Print Pros (2088 US-130).
issues.fix: Add these three after a quick address/ownership check.
